items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Frankie Dooson; the interviewer asks questions about him ('Is there anything else you can tell about Frankie Dooson?') and the interviewee does not provide a personal response regarding their relationship.

ctx.x: Well, I played outfield, I caught nine years. I caught nine years. I played pretty much all in position.

Yeah, I guess try them all. Is there anything else you can tell about Frankie Dooson? Where did he live? Where was his house about? Where did he hang out? Nah. Did he get along all right with Buddy Johnson? Were they rivals?
Yeah, they did. They played together.
